message.content:
(A) The native OS arrow cursor is located in the upper-right area of the crop, positioned just above the circle. It is a small, white arrow pointing up and to the left.
(B) There is a large, grey circle (ring) in the lower-right portion of the image. The arrow cursor is **OUTSIDE** the circle. The circle is **not** centered on the arrow cursor; it is positioned below and slightly to the left of it.
